text:
Nora: FYI partner asked for an end-to-end marketplace gating plan that covers H100/H200, MI300, B200 and a small Gaudi note. They want ETA for compatibility rows, canary plan, and a short press embargo statement.
Ben: I can own the gating plan doc. Will need perf signoff and SI install window. Can @Kai confirm perf times?
Kai: Perf runs scheduled in staging: H100 baseline tonight, MI300 tomorrow morning, H200 + B200 tomorrow afternoon. B200 will need thermal profile tests (power capping affects perf).
Marisol: For SI/integration we need exact image tags and the minimal runbook so partners can validate in their lab. Please post tags asap.
Diego: Staging tags (WIP):
```
redwood/runtime:1.0.0-h100-rc2
redwood/runtime:1.0.0-mi300-rc2
redwood/runtime:1.0.0-b200-rc1
redwood/runtime:1.0.0-gaudi-community-rc
kernel: 5.15.90 + nvidia-540.2-rc
```
Nora: Include a separate B200 compatibility row called "B200 power/thermal note". Partner engineering insisted on that.
Ben: Draft gating steps: 1) compatibility matrix completion; 2) SI dry-run; 3) dedicated canary (3% traffic) -> broad canary (20%) -> GA. Need owners for each.
Kai: Owner assignments: perf tests -> me; canary routing -> I'll work with infra to pin to dedicated pools; SI dry-run -> Marisol; driver/firmware signoff -> Diego.
Marisol: SI dry-run window available Fri-Sat. I'll coordinate partner SIs; need a succinct one-step install command for partners.
Diego: One-liner runbook for partners: `docker pull redwood/runtime:1.0.0-mi300-rc2 && sudo systemctl restart redwood-runtime && ./tools/check_gpu.sh --quick`
Ben: Embargo blurb for press (short): "Partner x and Redwood are coordinating a staged marketplace listing. Final availability subject to compatibility signoff; customers will be notified at least 48 hours prior to public listing." Keep it conservative.
Nora: Partners asked for an internal "handshake" timeline: we proposed 96h for partner review after we share matrix, 48h for final signoff, then 24-48h for canary validation. Thoughts?
Kai: 96h review seems fine. But we should require partner ack (email thread or signed Jira ticket) for signoff. Add that to the plan.
Marisol: Also adding an escalation path for SI failures: pager for oncall-runtime, and partner-resp lead. I'll paste short snippet later.
Ben: Can we route the initial canary to Dedicated/us-east-1 only, and use auto-fallback to Private clusters if dedicated capacity hit? I want Hosted excluded for first 48h.
Kai: Agreed. I'll add a routing policy: canary -> dedicated/us-east-1 (3%) -> fallback -> private/eu-west-1 (if capacity) -> hosted-low-prio.
Diego: Logging ask from partner: they want a trimmed sample log we can provide that scrubs PII. I'll add a sample to the matrix doc.
Nora: Add Gaudi as a roadmap note only: "Gaudi community image validated for smoke tests; full certification planned post-GA". Do not commit dates.
Ben: Link to draft matrix & canary plan: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/def456-gating (edit for owners).
Marisol: Ops-bot, can you create an internal calendar block for the partner handshake review meeting at Fri 10:00 PDT?
ops-bot: Created event "Partner HW Gating Review: H100/MI300/B200" Fri 10:00 PDT, invited: Nora, Ben, Kai, Marisol, Diego.
Marisol: Quick example of the SI escalation snippet I'll add to the spreadsheet: "If GPU memory ECC errors occur during SI dry-run, call runtime-oncall -> +1-555-2345 and open Jira RED-1111. If firmware mismatch, escalate to Diego and pause canary."
Diego: Noted. Also adding driver rollback steps and git hash references to the matrix.
Kai: Perf ETA: I'll post numeric perf deltas after the MI300 run (expected by 2023-11-16 09:00 PST). Logs will go to gs://redwood-staging/gpu-gating/3805554321/.
Nora: Action items recap: Ben -> finalize matrix + embargo copy (Thu EOD). Kai -> upload perf logs + routing policy (Thu night). Marisol -> SI schedule + runbook (Fri morning). Diego -> driver hashes + rollback steps (Thu morning).
Ben: I'll update the spreadsheet and ping this thread when it's ready. :thumbsup:
Nora: Thanks all. Keep replies short in partner-facing docs. We want single-source-of-truth and minimal ambiguity.
Marisol: Will do.
Ben: Closing note - partner asked if we can include a brief marketplace bullet about "approximate availability" phrased as "targeting Q4 with staged rollout". Keep it non-binding.
Nora: Approved. Add as "targeting Q4" in the matrix as requested.
Ben: Thanks team. I'll post the final matrix link here when owner edit access is granted.
Kai: Uploading logs now.
Diego: Will add the driver hashes shortly.
Marisol: SI invites sent to partner contacts.
Nora: Great work.
